settings.description: Vector MCP endpoint URL (default: https://vector-api.pharosone.ai/api/v1/mcp/). Trailing slash matters: the server 307-redirects bare /mcp → /mcp/ and some clients dislike that. Set a custom URL only for private Vector deployments.
